claim_under_comparison: C6 arbitrary-independent-amplitude Pfaffian formula for P=Dt+c1Dx+c3Dx^3, all finite N

verified_primary_comparison.source: J. Hietarinta, Introduction to the Hirota bilinear method, arXiv:solv-int/9708006, section 4.2, equations 32-38
verified_primary_comparison.what_was_read: Author's complete 1997 primary summary, especially the rotation to both equations on one tau pair and equation 37.
verified_primary_comparison.exact_dictionary: aH=0; xH=x-c1*t, yH=c3*t, tH=y. P=c3*(DxH^3+DyH); DyP=c3*DtH*(DxH^3+DyH). Equivalently (xH,yH,tH)=(X,-s,y), X=x-c1*t,s=-c3*t.
verified_primary_comparison.limitation: The summary's two seed types and three-soliton classification are not an explicit all-N arbitrary-amplitude Pfaffian theorem. The original 1987 paper II has not been read in full.
